localChanges: With ?interface=new, choosing what to research shows each advance's cost in bulbs and how many turns it will take, with what it needs and leads to beside the list, and the button says what it will do ("Research Atomic Theory") (#745).

With ?interface=new, choosing a government after a revolution, your civilization (Random first) and your leader, a difficulty for an older save, and an advance to take from a captured city or in an exchange all use the same list, and each button says what it will do ("Adopt Monarchy", "Play as the Romans").
With ?interface=new, New Game's questions use it too: the map grid, the world's size, the difficulty and how many civilizations, the last button starting the game ("Start with 7 civilizations").
